(c)The Existing Mortgages, the Existing Notes and all documents executed
and delivered in connection with this Agreement have been duly authorized, executed and
delivered by Borrower and constitute legal, valid and binding obligations of Borrower,
enforceable against Borrower in accordance with their respective terms without offset, defense or
counterclaim, subject to applicable bankruptcy, insolvency and similar laws affecting the rights
of creditors generally, and general principles of equity.
(d)The Existing Mortgages are valid mortgage liens in favor of the Lender on
the Property, securing the indebtedness evidenced by the Existing Notes.
3.The liens of the Existing Mortgages are hereby consolidated and coordinated so
that they shall hereafter constitute but one mortgage, a single lien, upon the Property securing the
principal amount of up to EIGHTY MILLION and 00/100 DOLLARS ($80,000,000.00).
4.The terms of the Existing Mortgages are hereby modified, restated, superseded,
subsumed into, and controlled by the terms, covenants, provisions, and conditions contained in
the Consolidated, Amended and Restated Mortgage, Assignment of Leases and Rents, Security
Agreement and Fixture Filing as set forth in Exhibit C annexed hereto and made a part hereof
(the “Consolidated Mortgage"). Borrower and Lender hereby agree that, when the terms,
covenants or provisions contained in the Existing Mortgages conflict with the terms, covenants,
provisions, and conditions contained in Éxhibit C hereto, the terms, covenants, provisions and
conditions contained in Exhibit C hereto shall prevail, except that nothing herein will extinguish,
